source: 角色的背景代表了这个角色在成为冒险者之前的经历。通过创建一个独特的背景或对玩家手册中现有的背景进行修改，你可以反映战役的特定主题或是你世界中的独特元素。你也可以通过创建新的背景来帮助玩家为他们的角色制作心目中的起源故事。
target: A character's background represents their experiences before becoming an adventurer. By creating a unique background or modifying an existing background from the Player's Handbook, you can reflect particular themes of your campaign or distinctive elements of your world. You can also create new backgrounds to help players give their characters the origin stories they have in mind.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H2, Custom Background. All three source sentences are translated. Nearby ability, feat, skill, tool, and equipment choices are context only and are not added to this prose cell. No text from a 2014 entry was substituted.

source: 你在一座寺庙中全心全意的侍奉，或是挂单在城镇中，或是幽居在圣所。你在那里执掌祭仪崇敬一位神祇或是众神。多亏了你的祭司教导和你的虔诚，你也掌握了如何引导一点点神力来为你的崇敬祈祷和在那里祷告的人们提供司教服务。
target: You devoted yourself wholeheartedly to service in a temple, whether lodging in a town or living in seclusion in a sanctuary. There, you conducted rites in honor of a deity or a pantheon. Thanks to your priest's teaching and your own devotion, you also learned to channel a little divine power into your worship and prayers and into ministering to the people who prayed there.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H3, Acolyte. The wording about lodging and seclusion follows this supplied Chinese passage. The modest divine power and service to worshippers are both retained; no additional spellcasting rules are inferred from the adjacent feat.

source: 你在力气足以提起水桶时，就开始于工匠工坊里以拖地和擦洗度日，每天挣那么几个铜板。当你长到成为学徒的年龄时，你学会了自己制作基本的手工艺品，还有面对刁钻客户时该说什么好话。你的买卖也让你对消息琐事有敏锐的洞察力。
target: As soon as you were strong enough to lift a bucket, you began spending your days mopping and scrubbing in an artisan's workshop, earning a few copper coins a day. When you were old enough to become an apprentice, you learned to make basic crafted goods yourself and to find the right words for difficult customers. Your trade also gave you a keen awareness of news and small details.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H4, Artisan. Retains the bucket, cleaning work, daily copper earnings, apprenticeship, basic goods, difficult customers, and awareness of information and details. No mechanics or quantities have been added.

source: 在你长到能买酒的年纪后，你立刻就在家乡方圆十里内的所有酒吧拥有了自己专属的钟意座位。当你在各个酒吧间穿梭时，你学会了如何用善意的谎言去安抚那些需要安慰的可怜人——也许是一剂包治百病的良方或是一份伪造的血统证明。
target: As soon as you were old enough to buy a drink, you quickly claimed a favorite seat of your own in every tavern within ten li of your hometown. As you moved from tavern to tavern, you learned to soothe unfortunate people in need of reassurance with kindly lies, perhaps offering a cure for every ailment or a forged certificate of lineage.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H5, Charlatan. The source distance is ten li; it is retained as ten li rather than silently changed to ten miles or converted under an assumed historical unit. Both examples of deception are translated.

source: 你年轻时大部分时间都在参加巡回演出和嘉年华会，为音乐家和杂技演员们做零工以换取学习的机会。你可能已经学会了如何走钢丝，如何弹奏风格独特的鲁特琴，或是用怎样无可挑剔的发音方式吟诵诗歌。而现如今，你在喝彩声中茁壮成长，渴望登上舞台。
target: You spent much of your youth with touring shows and carnivals, doing odd jobs for musicians and acrobats in exchange for opportunities to learn. You might have learned to walk a tightrope, play a lute in a distinctive style, or recite poetry with impeccable diction. Now you thrive on applause and long to take the stage.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H7, Entertainer. All three possible performance skills and the exchange of work for instruction are retained. These are narrative examples, not additional proficiencies.

source: 你在野外长大，远离定居区。你的家就在你决定打开铺盖的任何地方。荒野中自有奇妙之处——奇特的怪物、原始的森林和溪流；如今杂草丛生的、曾被巨人踏过的大殿废墟。在探索它们的过程中你学会了保护自己。而时不时的，你会遇到亲爱的自然祭司，他们会指导你掌握怎样运用荒野的魔法。
target: You grew up in the wilds, far from settled places. Home was wherever you chose to unroll your bedroll. The wilderness had wonders of its own: strange monsters, primeval forests and streams, and ruined halls, now overgrown, where giants once trod. You learned to protect yourself as you explored them. From time to time, you met kindly priests of nature who taught you how to use the magic of the wilds.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H10, Guide. Retains all listed wilderness wonders, self-defense, and occasional instruction from nature priests. The neighboring Druid feat does not replace or expand this narrative.

source: 你曾作为一名学徒学习着商业的基础知识，你的师傅是一名商贩、商队的领队或是某位商铺的店主。你旅行八方，靠着买入和卖出工匠们所需的原材料和这些工匠的制品赚钱谋生。你可能需要把这些货物从一个地方运输到另一个地方（通过船、货货车还有商队），又或是从旅行商人那里订货，然后在自己店里销售。
target: You learned the fundamentals of commerce as an apprentice to a trader, a caravan leader, or a shopkeeper. You traveled far and wide, making a living by buying and selling the raw materials artisans needed and the goods they produced. You might have transported those goods from place to place by ship, wagon, or caravan, or ordered them from traveling merchants and sold them in your own shop.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H12, Merchant. Retains all three possible mentors, both raw materials and finished goods, all three transport methods, and the alternative shop arrangement. A repeated character in the source word for wagon is treated as a typographical duplication, not an extra vehicle.

source: 权力、财富还有荣耀伴随你在城堡中长大，你那贵不可言的小家族确保你受到了一流的教育，其中有些教导令你感激，而有些则只让你觉得愤慨。在城堡中的时光，尤其是在长久以来耳濡目染于宫廷中的家族往来，也培养了你足以胜任领袖的许多才能。
target: You grew up in a castle surrounded by power, wealth, and honor. Your small noble family ensured that you received an excellent education, some of which you appreciated and some of which you resented. Your time in the castle, especially your long exposure to the family's dealings at court, also developed many of the abilities you would need to be a capable leader.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H13, Noble. Preserves the source's small family, mixed feelings about education, court dealings, and leadership preparation. No additional social privilege or mechanical benefit is supplied.

source: 你长大的岁月便在宅邸和修行院之间的奔波中过去，做着各式各样的零活和服务，以此访问他们的图书馆藏。你花了那么多漫长的夜晚学习书籍和卷册，阅览多元宇宙的见闻，甚至涉猎魔法的本质——而你的心灵正渴望着了解更多。
target: You spent your formative years moving between manor houses and monasteries, performing all manner of odd jobs and services to gain access to their libraries. You devoted many long nights to studying books and scrolls, learning about the multiverse and even exploring the nature of magic. Your mind still hungers to learn more.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H14, Sage. Translates both kinds of institution, work exchanged for library access, books and scrolls, the multiverse, and the nature of magic. Does not borrow a different Sage background description.

source: 你成长的时期都在缮写室度过，那是一座致力于保存知识的修道院，或是某个政府机关。你在那里学会了如何书写思维敏锐有逻辑的文字和怎样制作得体的书面文本，有时你会抄录政府文件或是誊抄文献巨著。你可能有一些诗歌写作的技艺、叙事的技巧或是学术上的研究。最重要的是，你对琐碎处的关注很细致。这能帮助你避免在誊录和撰写文稿时出现错误。
target: You spent your formative years in a scriptorium, whether at a monastery devoted to preserving knowledge or in a government office. There, you learned to express keen, logical thought in writing and to produce presentable written documents. Sometimes you copied government records or transcribed major literary works. You might have some skill in writing poetry, telling stories, or conducting scholarly research. Above all, you pay meticulous attention to small details, helping you avoid errors when copying and composing manuscripts.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H16, Scribe. Retains both possible settings, both document-copying examples, all three possible areas of expertise, and the stated reason for attention to detail.

source: 你从成年开始便接受战阵训练，鲜少有拿起武器之前的生活回忆，战斗已融入你的血液。有时候你会发现自己正在反复操练着最初学会的基本战斗训练。而最终，你会将这些训练运用到战场上，在战争中行使武力，保护你的王国。
target: You have trained for battle ever since you came of age, and you have few memories of life before you took up a weapon. Fighting is in your blood. Sometimes you find yourself repeating the basic combat drills you first learned. Ultimately, you will put that training to use on the battlefield, wielding force in war to protect your kingdom.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H17, Soldier. Preserves the supplied starting point at adulthood and its future-facing statement about applying the training, rather than replacing either with remembered wording from another edition.

source: 你在街头长大，身边都是同样命途多舛的孤儿，有些是朋友有些是对头。你露宿街头，只靠着打零工来换取食物。有些时候你会感到饥饿难耐，但却只能以盗窃维生。尽管如此，你从未抛你的自尊，也从未放弃希望。命运还没有就此关上大门。
target: You grew up on the streets among other orphans whose lives were as troubled as your own. Some were friends, and others were rivals. You slept in the open and relied on odd jobs in exchange for food. At times, hunger became unbearable, and theft was your only means of survival. Even so, you never abandoned your self-respect or gave up hope. Fate has not yet closed the door on you.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H18, Wayfarer. All circumstances and the concluding hope are retained. The incomplete source verb meaning abandon is translated according to its clear sentence context; no event or benefit is added.

source:
当你长大之时，你加入了城市守卫，并且坚定的站在了对抗犯罪的第一线。你并不是一名抵御外来敌人的战士，相反，你是服务于你的城镇，帮助民众们处理罪犯，从犯法者和作恶者们手上保护城市。（未翻译完全，以下是原文） 
You have served the community where you grew up, standing as its first line of defense against crime. You aren't a soldier, directing your gaze outward at possible enemies. Instead, your service to your hometown was to help police its populace, protecting the citizenry from lawbreakers and malefactors of every stripe.

You might have been part of the City Watch of Waterdeep, the baton-wielding police force of the City of Splendors, protecting the common folk from thieves and rowdy nobility alike. Or you might have been one of the valiant defenders of Silverymoon, a member of the Silverwatch or even one of the magic-wielding Spellguard.

Perhaps you hail from Neverwinter and have served as one of its Wintershield watchmen, the newly founded branch of guards who vow to keep safe the City of Skilled Hands.

Even if you're not city-born or city-bred, this background can describe your early years as a member of law enforcement. Most settlements of any size have their own constables and police forces, and even smaller communities have sheriffs and bailiffs who stand ready to protect their community.
target:
As you grew up, you joined the city watch and stood firmly on the front line against crime. You were not a warrior defending against enemies from outside. Instead, you served your town, helping its people deal with criminals and protecting the city from lawbreakers and wrongdoers. (Translation incomplete; the original text follows.)
You have served the community where you grew up, standing as its first line of defense against crime. You aren't a soldier, directing your gaze outward at possible enemies. Instead, your service to your hometown was to help police its populace, protecting the citizenry from lawbreakers and malefactors of every stripe.

You might have been part of the City Watch of Waterdeep, the baton-wielding police force of the City of Splendors, protecting the common folk from thieves and rowdy nobility alike. Or you might have been one of the valiant defenders of Silverymoon, a member of the Silverwatch or even one of the magic-wielding Spellguard.

Perhaps you hail from Neverwinter and have served as one of its Wintershield watchmen, the newly founded branch of guards who vow to keep safe the City of Skilled Hands.

Even if you're not city-born or city-bred, this background can describe your early years as a member of law enforcement. Most settlements of any size have their own constables and police forces, and even smaller communities have sheriffs and bailiffs who stand ready to protect their community.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H19, City Watch. The source contains a partial Chinese introduction, an editorial translation-status note, and a complete existing English passage. The Chinese portion and note are translated, and every existing English paragraph is retained verbatim from the supplied workbook, including its proper names. This intentionally preserves the source duplication to meet the no-omissions requirement; editorial deduplication would be a separate change. No external book text was fetched.

source: 比警戒或是巡逻人员更稀有的是组织的调查员，专门负责调查犯罪后的真相。尽管这些人很少出现在乡村地带，几乎每一个像样规模的案子都会有一个或者两个有调查犯罪现场和追踪罪犯技能的调查员。如果你曾经是一名调查员，则你可以将背景的运动技能熟练项替换为调查技能熟练项。
target: An organization's investigators, who specialize in uncovering the truth after a crime, are rarer than its sentries or patrol officers. Although these people seldom appear in rural areas, nearly every sizable case has one or two investigators skilled in examining crime scenes and tracking down criminals. If you were an investigator, you can replace this background's proficiency in Athletics with proficiency in Investigation.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H20, City Watch Variant: Investigator. Preserves one or two investigators and the optional Athletics-to-Investigation proficiency replacement. The source explicitly refers to a sizable case, not a settlement; that wording is retained despite its awkward context. The adjacent skills cell still lists Athletics and Insight, so no silent replacement is made outside this conditional prose.

source:
The Stout Folk 以他们的工艺和手工的价值而闻名，而你则一直在接受这门技艺的训练。多年来，你一直在一名矮人大师的门下学习磨练，为的就是今日你所拥有的好技艺。
你很可能是一名矮人，但这并不是必定的——特别是在北地，盾矮人部族们在很久之前就已经学到了只有自傲的傻瓜们才会在意学徒们的手艺会超过自己而拒绝收受徒弟，即使是其他种族的学徒。如果你不是一名矮人，无论如何你必须立下一个庄重的誓言，你在这门工艺上绝不收徒：只因这并非是为非矮人们传承这门摩拉丁青睐的子民们的技艺。不过，你能很轻松的找到一名矮人大师传授你技艺之余，传授被你推荐而来的人们这门技艺。
target:
The Stout Folk are renowned for their craftsmanship and the value of their handiwork, and you have long trained in this craft. You spent years studying and refining your skills under a dwarf master to achieve the expertise you now possess.
You are likely a dwarf, but not necessarily. This is especially true in the North, where shield dwarf clans learned long ago that only arrogant fools refuse apprentices for fear that their pupils might surpass them, even when those apprentices come from other races. If you are not a dwarf, however, you must swear a solemn oath never to take on an apprentice in this craft: it is not for non-dwarves to pass on the skills of Moradin's favored people. You can, however, readily find a dwarf master who will teach people you recommend as well as continuing your own instruction.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H21, Clan Crafter. Keeps the supplied English epithet The Stout Folk and translates the dwarf, shield dwarf, and Moradin context. The source's explanation about fear of apprentices surpassing a master is retained. The non-dwarf's absolute oath against taking apprentices and the alternative referral to a dwarf master are both preserved; no broader permission to teach is inferred.

source:
孩提时代，好奇的你与喧闹和孤独为伴。在你成长的岁月中，你发现了一所费伦最伟大的学习学院，你在那里学习，并认为知识是比黄金宝石更为有价值的财富。现在，你已经准备好了离开你的居所-并不是放弃它，而是寻找新的知识来充实它。 
费伦最知名的知识之所是烛堡。这所最伟大的图书馆总是会需要工人和仆人，一些人还会被升格成为拥有重大突出责任等级的角色。你可能是其中一名烛堡的拥有者，致力于做一个完善这个世界的学识体系和历史的管理者。
target:
As a child, you were curious, and your days were filled with both commotion and solitude. As you grew up, you found one of Faerûn's greatest colleges of learning. You studied there and came to regard knowledge as a treasure more valuable than gold or gems. Now you are ready to leave your home, not to abandon it, but to seek new knowledge with which to enrich it.
Faerûn's best-known repository of knowledge is Candlekeep. This great library always needs workers and servants, and some are promoted to positions of considerable responsibility. You might be one of Candlekeep's owners, devoted to serving as a steward who enriches the world's body of knowledge and history.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H22, Cloistered Scholar. Translates all supplied sentences, including commotion and solitude. The source calls the possible Candlekeep role an owner; owner is retained literally. Whether an institutional title such as a member of the Avowed was intended cannot be established from this row, so no such title is silently substituted. The awkward source phrase about promotion is rendered as positions of considerable responsibility.

source:
早些时候，你是一名贵族法院或者官场的重要人士。你可能或者不是来自某个上流社会的家族之中；你用你的才能，而不是你出生的背景让你赢得了这个位置。 
你可能是一名银月法庭的政府人员，仆人，或者是随从。亦或你旅行至深水城时被招募成为某个杀手公会，贵族，冒险家或秘密社团的一员。你可能是一个在博德之门或是无冬城维护法纪的幕后工作人员。亦可能成长在匕首滩城堡之中。
即使你已不再是那个给了你生活的开始的组织中的一员，你与以前同事们之间的人际关机可以给你和你冒险伙伴们一些优势。你也可能会和现在新的伙伴们从之前的组织中接到任务。在任何情况下，你曾经作为朝臣的能力会使你在冒险生活中处于更有利的境地。
target:
Earlier in life, you were an important figure in a noble court or in government. You might or might not have come from a high-society family; your talents, rather than your birth, earned you that position.
You might have been an official, servant, or attendant at the court of Silverymoon. Alternatively, while traveling to Waterdeep, you might have been recruited by an assassins' guild, nobles, adventurers, or a secret society. You might have worked behind the scenes to uphold law and order in Baldur's Gate or Neverwinter. Or you might have grown up in the castle at Daggerford.
Even if you no longer belong to the organization that gave you your start in life, your relationships with former colleagues can give you and your adventuring companions certain advantages. You and your new companions might also receive assignments from your former organization. Whatever the circumstances, the abilities you developed as a courtier will serve you well in your adventuring life.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H23, Courtier. Retains all named places, possible employers, former colleagues, and possible assignments. Assassins' guild follows the explicit source wording and is not softened to a generic guild. The corrupted phrase about interpersonal relationships is read in its immediate colleagues context. The phrase about a noble court may refer to a courtly institution rather than a judicial court; the English court preserves that ambiguity.

source:
有许多的组织活跃在北地和费伦大陆的表面，他们并不会收到地理位置限制。这些组织会追寻他们的理念，有时候甚至不会遵循政治方面的界限，只要组织认为有必要，任何地点都可以有他们成员的存在。这些组织会雇佣一些听众，造谣者，走私者，佣兵，秘密守护者（那些专门守护为组织所用的财宝或是魔法的守卫们），港口看守，信使等等人员来做一些事情。 一个组织的核心人员们并不只会执行那些小任务，他们会是组织的臂膀、心脏、头脑。 
在你冒险故事的开始（准备阶段），你以某个费伦中特定组织的代理人身份存在。你可能由于你自身公开或私密的目的依靠这个组织和它追寻的理想。成为一个冒险者并不需要你放弃现有加入的组织（虽然你也可以这么做），说不定这段冒险还会提升你在组织中的地位呢。
target:
Many organizations operate throughout the North and across the surface of Faerûn without being confined by geography. They pursue their ideals, sometimes disregarding political boundaries, and their members can be found wherever the organization considers their presence necessary. These organizations employ listeners, rumor-mongers, smugglers, mercenaries, secret guardians (guards specifically charged with protecting treasure or magic used by the organization), harbor watchmen, couriers, and others to carry out their work. An organization's core members do more than handle small tasks: they are its arms, heart, and mind.
At the beginning of your adventuring story, during its preparatory stage, you serve as an agent of a particular organization in Faerûn. You might rely on that organization and the ideals it pursues for reasons of your own, whether those reasons are public or private. Becoming an adventurer does not require you to leave your current organization, though you can choose to do so. Your adventures might even improve your standing within it.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H24, Faction Agent. Preserves all seven named kinds of worker, the explanation of secret guardians, geographical and political reach, private or public motives, optional departure, and possible advancement. Listeners is a faithful rendering of the source's unusual occupational term; no different intelligence role is imposed from another text.

source:
几乎所有沿着剑湾和北地遇见的所有普通大众和其他种族的人们都有一个共同之处：他们通常会旅行至他们出生地点超过好几里的生活。 
你就是这样的一群人中的一员。
你来自一个遥远的地方，一个如此偏远以至于很多北地的普通大众们都没有知道这个地方的存在，即使你遇到过一些人听说过你的家乡，他们也仅仅是知道名字亦或可能还知道一点点骇人听闻的故事。你由于自己个人的原因来到了费伦大陆现在所处之地，这个原因你也许或未必愿意将它分享给其他人。
虽然你发现这片土地的有着一些冷漠和破败的地方，你也能确信这里的一些人文也有你从前从来没有见过的新鲜之处。你是一个无论走到什么地方都对周围环境中的善良或是邪恶感兴趣的人。
target:
Almost all the common folk and people of other races you meet along the Sword Coast and in the North share one thing: they usually travel more than a few li from their birthplace over the course of their lives.
You are one of these people.
You come from a distant place, somewhere so remote that many ordinary people of the North do not even know it exists. Even those you have met who have heard of your homeland know little more than its name and perhaps a few sensational stories. You came to the part of Faerûn where you are now for a personal reason, one you might or might not be willing to share with others.
Although parts of this land strike you as cold and run-down, you can also be sure that some of its people and customs offer things you have never encountered before. Wherever you go, you take an interest in the good and evil in your surroundings.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H25, Far Traveler. The source affirmatively says people usually travel beyond a few li and says you are one of them; both are retained, without inserting a presumed missing negative. Li is not silently converted to miles. The final sentence explicitly makes you interested in nearby good and evil, so its subject is preserved rather than reversed to other people's interest in you. These may be source translation problems, but this row alone does not authorize replacing them with another edition's prose.

source: 你是一些很有价值的东西的继承者不单单指的是金币或是财富，而是某个单独委托给你的东西。你继承的财产可能是直接是由于你出生就是是你家族中的一员，或者它可能是从你的指导者、老师或者其他在你生命中重要的人那里留下给你的东西，你所得的遗产启示了你，改变了你的生活，指引你走上了冒险的道路，同时它也可能会带来许多的危险，包括哪些窥探你遗产，（用力量，如果需要的话）想把他从你手中夺走的家伙。
target: You are the heir to something valuable: not merely gold or wealth, but something entrusted to you alone. Your inheritance might have come to you simply because you were born into your family, or it might have been left to you by a mentor, teacher, or someone else important in your life. The inheritance has inspired you, changed your life, and set you on the path to adventure. It can also bring many dangers, including people who covet it and want to take it from you, by force if necessary.
note: 2024 workbook, Background H26, Inheritor. Retains the distinction from ordinary wealth, sole entrustment, family or mentor/teacher/other benefactor origins, inspiration and changed life, the path to adventure, and the possibility of forcible theft. Repeated words in the source are normalized without dropping any substantive clause.
